name: Young Canada Works
eligibilitySummary: Federal wage subsidy program helping employers create summer work opportunities for youth aged 16 to 30. Supports heritage, arts, cultural, and environmental organizations in hiring young Canadians.

funding.description: Wage subsidy covering 50-75% of wages for youth employees (ages 16-30). Maximum subsidy of $25,000 per position, with enhanced rates for organizations serving official language minority communities.

application.applicationRequirements: Must be a Canadian heritage, arts, cultural, or environmental organization. Positions must provide meaningful work experience for youth aged 16-30. Employers must contribute a minimum 25% of total wages.
